# yellowdog_machine_image_family (Resource)

Defines a family of versions of machine image groups.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An image family is the top level of the machine image hierarchy: a family
# holds groups, typically one per version, and a group holds the equivalent
# image in each cloud provider and region.
resource "yellowdog_machine_image_family" "example" {
  name      = "example-image-family"
  namespace = "example-namespace"
  os_type   = "LINUX"
  access    = "PRIVATE"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The user allocated name used to uniquely identify this machine image family within its namespace.
- `namespace` (String) The user allocated namespace used to group machine image families and other objects together.
- `os_type` (String) The operating system type of all images within this machine image family.

### Optional

- `access` (String) The access level for this machine image family and any contained groups and images.

  Defaults to `"PRIVATE"`.
- `metadata_specification` (Map of String) A map of user-definable key-value pairs used to specify metadata keys and, optionally, values required to be on all images within the machine image family.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is the image family's YDID.
terraform import yellowdog_machine_image_family.example ydid:imgfam:000000:00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
